'1971 Shei Shob Din' trailer to release today
2023-08-10T11:17:12+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/1971-shei-shob-din-trailer-release-today-3390821

Hridi Huq directorial "1971 Shei Shob Din" finally released its digital poster yesterday, and also revealed that the trailer will be unveiled on August 10 at 7 pm.

Recently, the makers have released two songs from the film - "Jachchho Kothay" and Urdu song "Ye Shamey." The audiences appreciated both songs as they beautifully portrayed the essence of 1971.

Starring Shajal Noor and Sanjida Preeti, "Jachchho Kothay" encapsulates the essence of a bygone era with earthy colour tone and 70s cultural landscape. While "Ye Shamey" gives a modern twist to Urdu song where Sonia Hossain portrays a sensual songstress of the 70s.

"1971 Shei Shob Din" revolves around a family's experiences during 1971, providing a poignant portrayal of the era.

Hridi Haq’s ‘1971 Shei Shob Din’ release date announced

Apart from directing, Hridi Huq herself features in "1971 Shei Shob Din", alongside a talented ensemble cast comprising of Mamunur Rashid, Jayanta Chattopadhyay, Munmun Ahmed, Shilpi Sharkar Apu, Ferdous, Tareen, Litu Anam, Saju Khadem, Sanjida Preeti, and many more. Notably, Litu Anam makes a remarkable comeback to cinema with this film after a hiatus of 15 years.
